info.name: Employee Onboarding - Phase 4 (two roles)
info.description: CRUD backend on AWS. Set the collection variable `baseUrl` to the ApiBaseUrl stack output. Run the folder top to bottom: Create mints a fresh employee number into `runEmployeeId`, captures the created id into `employeeId`, and every later request reuses it. The employee number is the DynamoDB partition key, so a rerun cannot reuse the last run's number. The "Promotion, un-promotion and reassignment" folder is a second, independent top-to-bottom run covering the eleven promote/staff routes - it mints its own employee numbers (managerAId, managerBId, internXId, internYId, gateId) so it does not disturb employeeId from the run above. Run "Sign in" first either way.

request.description:
Exchanges the demo officials credentials for a signed JWT and stores it as {{token}}. Every request below inherits it as bearer auth, so this one has to run first - on its own, or as the first request of a collection run.

A 403 here means the deployed stack predates the login route. A 401 means the stack is not using the demo accounts; change {{username}} and {{password}}.
